prompt: Implement src/lru.js exporting class `LruCache` with constructor `new LruCache({ max, ttlMs = Infinity, now = Date.now })`. Methods: `get(key)` returns the value or undefined (an expired entry counts as missing and is removed; a hit makes the key most recently used), `set(key, value, { ttlMs } = {})` inserts/updates (updating makes it most recently used; a per-entry ttlMs overrides the default; when over `max`, evict least recently used entries, preferring to evict expired entries first), `has(key)` (like get but does not change recency), `delete(key)` returns boolean, `size` getter counting only non-expired entries, and `keys()` returning non-expired keys from least to most recently used. get, set, has and delete must be O(1) amortised: with no expiring entries the cache must handle 60k get/set calls at max 20000 in well under a second (scanning for expired entries is only acceptable when some entry has a finite TTL). `now` is injectable for tests. Write your own tests in test/ and run them with `node --test test/`.
